title: Peace adviser: New Bangsamoro Parliament must choose its leaders
summary: COTABATO CITY — Members of the newly elected Bangsamoro Parliament must be free to choose their leaders, including who will head the regional executive, Peace Adviser Mel Senen Sarmiento said on…

blocks.text: COTABATO CITY — Members of the newly elected Bangsamoro Parliament must be free to choose their leaders, including who will head the regional executive, Peace Adviser Mel Senen Sarmiento said on Wednesday. “The gains of the peace process must now be carried forward through the parliamentary process,” Sarmiento said in a statement. “Members of Parliament must be free to choose their leaders and determine who will lead the executive branch.” Respecting that choice, he said, “honors the essence of autonomy and self-determination, and the trust that voters have placed in their representatives.” READ: BFP claims majority in BARMM Parliament with 46-seat […]...
